title: The Complete History of the A Button Challenge
summary: A five-hour documentary history of the Super Mario 64 A button challenge, which aims to beat the game with as few A presses as possible. It covers the bugs and exploits discovered over the years.
why: Recommended as a deep-dive rabbit hole showing extraordinary knowledge of game internals.

quote.text: The amount of knowledge and abuse of bugs these guys are performing is insane.
